# llms.txt — varanasi documentation manifest

Author: Ramprasad

Machine-readable index of the repo's documentation. One line per doc.
Human-readable map: `docs/INDEX.md`.

## Root docs

- README.md: Product pitch, setup, FAQ. Start here for orientation.
- AGENTS.md: The agent contract — orientation, house law, exact commands. Paste-able as-is.
- WORLD.md: World Selfie Check integration (human verification).
- PROJECT.md: Milestones M1-M8, architecture + finance notes.
- ORIGINAL_REQUEST.md: Original build request context.

## AGENTS.md

- AGENTS.md: Cross-package handoff notes for coding agents. Orientation table, exact commands, conventions, never-do list.

## docs/

- docs/INDEX.md: Human-readable doc map (grouped by what each doc answers).
- docs/GLOSSARY.md: One-line definitions of all terms (mandate, x402, vUSD, chit, escrow, HCS...).
- docs/REFERENCE.md: Registry of facts — contract addresses, ports, env variables, exact commands, test matrix, CI checks.
- docs/TUTORIAL.md: Guided first run of the product for a human user.
- docs/HOWTO.md: Goal-oriented recipes — deploy a contract, add a payment rail, wire Privy, verify locally.
- docs/MANDATE.md: EIP-712 mandate spec (type string LOCKED). Single escrowed task lifecycle.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: Architecture — flows, contracts, data ownership, finance protocol.
- docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md: Security properties + review status.
- SECURITY.md: Report channel, isolation model (per-account browser vault; public ledger state), accepted risks.
- docs/DEMO.md: Onchain proof (Etherscan / HashScan links).
- docs/VIDEO_SCRIPT.md: Demo video narrative.
- docs/SUBMISSION.md: Hackathon submission metadata.

## Per-surface docs

- contracts/README.md: Foundry — build/test/deploy, Sepolia ENSv2 wiring table.
- agent/README.md: TS agent engine — setup, CLI commands, finance engine.
- service/README.md: Express x402 signal service — routes, setup, finance APIs.
- frontend/README.md: Next.js app — routes, identity (Privy), finance vault, build.
- agent/SKILL.md: The Graph "AI-from-scratch" skill — discovery, intel, reasoning.

## Verification

- CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): contracts (forge), agent (vitest), service
  (node:test + adversarial HTTP), frontend (typecheck+build), gitleaks.
- `docs/REFERENCE.md` §6: exact test counts, all offline-safe.
- run.sh: boots service :4021 + web :3000; `run.sh agent` runs one live loop (spends $0.01 — ask first).
